posts.headline: Statistic
posts.body:
65 million people worldwide live with dementia.
Lifestyle changes in your 40s reduce risk by up to 40%.

posts.headline: Statistic
posts.body:
Prostate problems affect 50% of men over 50, and 90% of men over 80.
Starting prevention in your 40s makes a massive difference.
posts.cta: Half of men over 50 have prostate issues.
